name: Revenue overview
prompt: Revenue overview: weekly revenue by channel, headline revenue and order KPIs, and the top channels and categories.

binding.sql: SELECT week AS week, channel AS channel, ROUND(SUM(revenue),0) AS revenue FROM revenue_trends GROUP BY week, channel ORDER BY week, channel

copy.title: Weekly revenue by channel
copy.caption: Web leads revenue almost every week, with retail close behind and mobile a distant fourth.

binding.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(revenue),0) AS revenue FROM revenue_trends

copy.title: Total revenue
copy.caption: $3.6M across all channels over the last 53 weeks.

binding.sql: SELECT SUM(orders) AS orders FROM revenue_trends
SELECT SUM(units) AS units FROM revenue_trends
SELECT channel AS channel, ROUND(SUM(revenue),0) AS revenue FROM revenue_trends GROUP BY channel ORDER BY revenue DESC

copy.title: Revenue by channel
copy.caption: Web ($1.44M) and retail ($1.08M) drive roughly two-thirds of revenue.

binding.sql: SELECT category AS category, ROUND(SUM(revenue),0) AS revenue FROM product_performance GROUP BY category ORDER BY revenue DESC

copy.title: Top categories
copy.caption: Home and Sports lead the catalog; Electronics trails despite premium pricing.
